home.meta.title: Seiyaku 誓約 — Non-custodial Smart-Contract Mandate Vaults
home.meta.desc: Rule vaults for traders and AI agents on X Layer. Instant tightening, delayed loosening, exits always open.
home.hero.title: A pledge to yourself, enforced onchain
home.hero.promise: Delegate execution to automated agents without giving up asset custody or control.
home.values.tightenDesc: Lower size limits, reduce daily volume, or freeze trading in a single transaction with zero delay.
home.values.loosenDesc: Any rule expansion or unfreeze requires a mandatory 24-hour timelock, giving you time to react.
home.values.exitsDesc: Swapping back to the base token (USDC) bypasses freeze, size, and volume limits for emergency de-risking.
home.steps.title: How it works
home.steps.subtitle: Six distinct stages from creation to automated trading.
home.steps.step1Desc: Create your vault and fund it with USDC subject to guardrail limits.
home.steps.step2Desc: Configure max trade size, daily cap, cooldown, and allowed tokens.
home.steps.step3Desc: Designate an automated trader key or secondary bot address.
home.steps.step4Desc: TapeOut processor evaluates 17 NAND gates before every trade.
home.steps.step5Desc: Valid trades execute on Uniswap V3; proceeds return to vault.
home.steps.step6Desc: Withdraw your capital at any time via a delayed owner withdrawal.
home.limits.title: Honest limitations by design
home.limits.point1Desc: 500 USDC maximum base balance per vault as an unaudited prototype guardrail.
home.limits.point2Desc: The trader key cannot withdraw or send funds to any external address.
home.limits.point3Desc: A rogue trader key can freeze or cancel loosening; replace them instantly with setTrader.
home.limits.point4Desc: Fee-on-transfer and rebasing tokens are unsupported by balance delta assertions.

about.meta.title: About Seiyaku — Architecture, Trust Model, and Limits
about.meta.desc: Complete technical overview of the 9 mandate rules, asymmetric timelocks, trust model, and known limitations.
about.header.title: How Seiyaku Works
about.header.subtitle: A vault design that separates custody from trading through an onchain rule circuit.
about.rules.title: The nine rules in plain language
about.asymmetry.title: Asymmetry of control: Tighten vs Loosen
about.asymmetry.subtitle: Safety parameters can be restricted immediately but relaxed only with advance warning.
about.asymmetry.tightenDesc: Either the owner or the trader can immediately freeze trading or tighten parameters (lower size, lower volume, fewer trades). Takes effect in the exact same transaction.
about.asymmetry.loosenDesc: Only the owner can queue a loosening proposal (increase trade size, add tokens, unfreeze). Enforces a mandatory 24-hour waiting period before execution.
about.exits.title: Why exits are always open
about.exits.desc: Property 4 ensures that swaps back to the base token (USDC) bypass mandate expiry, freeze status, daily volume limits, and trade size checks. As long as parameters are sane, the trader can liquidate volatile positions back to safety at any time, protecting the vault during market crashes.
about.trust.title: Trust model & scope of power
about.trust.subtitle: Who can do what: the owner, the trader key and the rule circuit.
about.trust.ownerCan: Deposit, queue delayed withdrawals, replace trader, queue delayed loosening, tighten immediately, freeze.
about.trust.ownerCannot: Bypass withdrawal timelock delay (min 24h), change owner address.
about.trust.traderCan: Execute swaps satisfying circuit rules, freeze trading immediately, tighten limits immediately, cancel pending loosening.
about.trust.traderCannot: Withdraw funds, loosen rules, alter owner, send tokens to arbitrary addresses.
about.trust.circuitCan: Evaluate 17 NAND gates on-chain to determine whether swap parameters satisfy the 9 mandate rules.
about.trust.circuitCannot: Hold custody, transfer tokens, mutate vault state, execute external calls.
about.limits.title: Protocol constants & limits
about.limits.minLoosenDelayVal: {hours} hours on public factory (120s on demo)
about.limits.minWithdrawDelayVal: {hours} hours on public factory (120s on demo)
about.priorArt.title: Prior art honesty & transparency
about.priorArt.desc: Seiyaku combines ideas from timelocked governance vaults, allowance modules and swap guards. What it adds is a rule check done by a small TapeOut circuit that anyone can call and verify, with a delay on every loosening and exits that stay open. Other TapeOut projects such as TapeGuard, OpenGate and TapeSafe also use circuits to enforce rules.

agents.permissions.title: Agent permissions & capabilities
agents.permissions.actionTradeDesc: Only if all 9 circuit rules evaluate to true. Swaps route through Uniswap V3 and return proceeds to the vault.
agents.permissions.actionTightenDesc: Can make trading limits stricter at any time with immediate effect.
agents.permissions.actionFreezeDesc: Can halt all buy trading immediately if anomalies or market risks are detected.
agents.permissions.actionCancelLoosenDes: Can cancel pending loosening proposals queued by the owner.
agents.permissions.actionWithdrawDesc: Zero withdrawal capability. Agent key cannot transfer funds to itself or any third party.
agents.permissions.actionLoosenDesc: Cannot increase limits, unfreeze the vault, or add new tokens.
agents.permissions.actionTransferDesc: Cannot call ERC20 transfer or approval to non-router contracts.
agents.format.title: Trade request format (TradeParams)
agents.format.desc: Every swap executed by an agent passes a TradeParams struct to vault.trade().
agents.reasons.title: Block reason codes (from explainBlock)
agents.reasons.desc: When previewTrade() or trade() returns false, explainBlock() returns one or more of these stable error identifiers:
agents.reasons.saneDesc: Sanity parameters invalid (zero address, deadline expired, or deadline too far in the future).
agents.reasons.tokenAllowedDesc: Target token is not in the vault's allowlist.
agents.reasons.notExpiredDesc: Vault mandate expiration timestamp has been reached.
agents.reasons.notFrozenDesc: Vault is currently frozen by the owner or trader.
agents.reasons.sizeOkDesc: Trade amount exceeds the configured maxTradeBase limit.
agents.reasons.dailyOkDesc: Cumulative daily buy volume exceeds maxDailyBase.
agents.reasons.cooldownOkDesc: Minimum cooldown duration between trades has not yet elapsed.
dashboard.fail.insane: The request is not valid (amount, deadline, token pair or fee tier).
dashboard.fail.notAllowed: This token is not on the allowlist.
dashboard.fail.size: The trade is larger than the per trade limit.
dashboard.fail.daily: This trade would pass today's volume limit.
dashboard.fail.trades: The daily number of buys is used up.
dashboard.fail.cooldown: The cooldown after the last buy is still running.
